features.quote: give_up(reason) — explicit abandon action. We give the model a first-class way to stop
features.justification_quote: the *manner* of stopping is exactly what we measure, and forcing it to stop via prose only would muddy parsing
long enough to let a spiral form, short enough to be cheap at scale

features.quote: Termination when: task verified, give_up called, budget exhausted, or N consecutive malformed/empty model turns
